fields.label: Use Kanban v2 (New Experience)
fields.description: Open this board in the new Kanban experience. When off, the classic Kanban is used. Same List / Kanban route either way.

fields.label: New Kanban
fields.description: Layout and fields used by the new Kanban experience for this board.

fields.label: Title Field
fields.description: Field shown as the card title: ID or a text field.

fields.label: Show Assigned To
fields.description: Show the assignee stack and Assign control on cards and in the hover preview.

fields.label: Show Tags on Cards
fields.description: Show document tags on cards (left of footer date), using the standard colored tag style.

fields.label: Image Field
fields.description: Attach Image field shown as a thumbnail before the card title.

fields.label: Footer Date
fields.description: Which timestamp to show in the card footer.

fields.label: Card Fields
fields.description: Fields shown on each card, in order. Set an Icon to show it on the card (label on hover); leave Icon empty to show the Label text. Leave the table empty to auto-pick.

fields.label: Preview Fields
fields.description: Fields shown in the card hover preview, in order. Icon and Label behave the same as Card Fields. Leave empty to use the doctype's preview fields, then card fields.

fields.label: Swimlanes
fields.description: Fields the board can group cards by (swimlanes). New boards are pre-filled with the doctype's Select fields (except the column field). Add Link fields to offer more groupings; leave empty to hide the Group button.
